title: Black Hat 2013 - Exploiting Network Surveillance Cameras Like a Hollywood Hacker
summary: Craig Heffner's Black Hat 2013 talk on exploiting network surveillance cameras, covering how insecure their firmware is. It shows how easily such devices can be compromised.
why: HN cites it as a fun and damning illustration of how poor security is in IP cameras, even expensive ones.

quote.text: Here's a pretty fun 2 year old talk from Blackhat, re surveillance camera firmware and how s*tty they are
